messages:
Ravi: Heads up — Citrine (dedicated/private) reported transient isolation during a peering event at 14:23 UTC. Not a full outage but service degraded for ~45s. Seen during a large KV checkpoint.
Mei: Which peering? citrine-prod <-> onprem-chi? Any firewall/appliance hints?
Ravi: Correct, onprem-chi. Customer sent syslogs showing TCP retransmits and some packet fragmentation warnings. pcap uploaded to ticket.
Julian: From quick trace looks like output queue saturation on the customer's edge. Similar to earlier peering regressions but different vendor (EdgeGuard v5).
Nora: Sounds recurring. We should treat this as part of the "peering cadence" pattern, not an isolated bug.
ops-bot: Created postmortem issue #PM-6798 with label `peering-cadence` and template `pm-onprem-peering-v2`. Attach: pcap_2361234567.pcap, bgp_counters_1423.log.
Mei: Immediate plan: 1) assign remediation owner; 2) enable ring pcap for 72h; 3) add correlation alert for checkpoint_active + retransmit_pct>0.7%; 4) add customer-facing note.
Ravi: I'll own remediation and customer comms.
Julian: I'll add capture hooks and widen tcpdump rotation. Also will add `net.egress.drop_pct` to peering telemetry. ETA: 24h.
Nora: I'll create a short-lived WG to validate two mitigations: a) jittered KV checkpoint scheduling per-tenancy, b) runtime pacing when egress drops >0.5% for >10s. Propose 10-day sprint.
Mei: I'll draft the customer note: "We're investigating intermittent peering isolation observed during KV checkpointing. Assigned remediation lead and WG; we'll share mitigations within 72 hours."
Ravi: Action items recorded in PM-6798: Ravi - owner & customer updates (72h), Julian - pcap hooks & telemetry (24h), Nora - WG + mitigation RFC (10 days), Mei - customer note & updates (24h).
Julian: For alerting: rule = (bgp_flap OR tcp_retransmit_pct>0.7) AND kv.checkpoint.active == true, route to #incidents and oncall.
Nora: Also add a retrospective ticket to correlate checkpoint start times across Citrine, Kestrel, and Helix to detect cadence collisions. Assign Platform SRE + Runtime.
ops-bot: Reminder: tag PM-6798 with `recurring-patterns` and set follow-up cadence to weekly until mitigations verified.
Ravi: Logging tweak: include `kv.checkpoint.size`, `kv.checkpoint.seed`, `kv.checkpoint.start_ts` in peering logs for 90 days.
Mei: Noted. Will add fields to the dashboard and share links in PM-6798.
citrine-net: We'll run MTU checks and send additional firewall captures on request.
Ravi: Thanks. WG invites and the postmortem draft will be posted in #incidents-wg. Closing here until WG kickoff. :thumbsup:
